subject.why: The heart foil balloon is instantly recognisable and complete with the curly ribbon and pink bow detail.

category.why: The balloon floats freely in the air without any surface below, tilted in three-quarter view against a saturated background with concentric rings.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, characters, or watermarks are present.

framing.why: The balloon is well-centred with comfortable margins on all sides and no cutoffs.

colour.why: The bright red balloon contrasts cleanly against the warm, juicy yellow background.

detail.why: No noisy textures or excessive micro-details; features are simplified and chunky.

style.why: Matches the reference style with soft satin highlights, chunky forms, and no outlines.
